## Summary by CodeRabbit

- Refactor
  - Unified runtime validations to a new tagged-template check across the codebase for clearer, consistent error messages. Removed the previous ensure-based pattern.
- Chores
  - Updated linting to allow tagged template expressions.
- Tests
  - Added tests validating the new check behavior and messaging.
- Documentation
  - Minor documentation touch-ups for clarity.

Note: No user-facing functionality changes; behavior remains the same aside from improved error reporting.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Replaces boolean-argument assertions with a tagged-template check across the codebase, removes ensure, updates affected modules to explicit guards/asOpaqueType, adjusts ESLint to allow tagged templates, and adds tests for the new check. Public APIs largely unchanged; primary edits are internal validation style and supporting utilities.

## Changes
| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Utils: Assertion API refactor**<br>`packages/core/utils/debug.ts` | Replaces check(condition[, message]) with tagged-template check; removes ensure and cast; updates exported check signature. |
| **Config**<br>`eslint.config.mjs` | Enables no-unused-expressions allowTaggedTemplates to support check tagged templates. |
| **Core: Assertion migration (bytes/codec/collections/crypto/erasure/shuffling/state-machine/trie/hash/concurrent/pvm-*)**<br>`packages/core/bytes/*`, `packages/core/codec/*`, `packages/core/collections/*`, `packages/core/concurrent/parent.ts`, `packages/core/crypto/*`, `packages/core/erasure-coding/erasure-coding.ts`, `packages/core/hash/allocator.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-debugger-adapter/debugger-adapter.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-host-calls/*`, `packages/core/pvm-interpreter/**`, `packages/core/shuffling/shuffling.ts`, `packages/core/state-machine/*`, `packages/core/trie/*` | Converts check(...) calls to tagged-template form check`...`; messages/conditions preserved; no public signature changes. Some files remove ensure usage in favor of check and explicit throws. |
| **Core: Ensure removal + opaque typing**<br>`packages/core/pvm-interpreter/memory/memory-index.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-interpreter/memory/pages/page-utils.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-interpreter/registers.ts`, `packages/core/codec/view.ts`, `packages/core/pvm-spi-decoder/decode-standard-program.ts`, `packages/core/numbers/index.ts` | Replaces ensure with tagged-template checks and explicit guards; adopts asOpaqueType/asTypedNumber where applicable; maintains public APIs. |
| **Core: New tests**<br>`packages/core/utils/debug.test.ts` | Adds tests covering tagged-template check behavior and message formatting. |

_⚠️ Potential issue_

**Bounds check misses negative indices**

Negative idx will access a negative typed-array index (silent bug). Guard lower bound too.

```diff
-    check`${idx < this.bitLength} Index out of bounds. Need ${idx} has ${this.bitLength}.`;
+    check`${idx >= 0 && idx < this.bitLength} Index out of bounds. Got ${idx}, allowed range: [0, ${this.bitLength}).`;
```
